notes: Characterization centers on the I2C-derived electrical bus (timing, thresholds, pull-ups), the SMBus robustness features (PEC, timeouts, SMBALERT#, ARP), and PMBus telemetry/format accuracy and fault behavior.
ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Bus timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify SMBCLK frequency range (10 kHz-1 MHz), setup/hold, and clock-low timeouts (Ttimeout, Tlow:sext, Tlow:mext).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: DC thresholds
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm VIL/VIH and pull-up / leakage windows for the device's threshold class.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PEC integrity
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject bit errors and confirm the CRC-8 PEC catches them (NACK).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SMBALERT# / ARA
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify alert assertion, arbitration, and release.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: ARP enumeration
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify UDID read and dynamic Assign-Address.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PMBus telemetry accuracy
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Compare READ_VOUT/IOUT/TEMPERATURE against references; validate LINEAR/DIRECT/VID decoding.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Fault response
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Force limit crossings and verify STATUS bits, SMBALERT#, and the configured response.
